{{2022–23 Big East men's basketball standings}}
The '''2022–23 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team''' represented [[Xavier University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]] as a member of the [[Big East Conference]]. Led by [[Sean Miller]] in the first season of his second stint after coaching the Musketeers from 2004 to 2009, they played their home games at the [[Cintas Center]] in [[Cincinnati|Cincinnati, Ohio]]. The Musketeers finished the season 23–8, 15–5 in Big East play to finish in second place. In the [[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] and [[2022–23 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] to reach the championship game, where they were defeated by [[2022–23 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]]. The team received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]], where they defeated [[2022–23 Kennesaw State Owls men's basketball team|Kennesaw State]] and [[2022–23 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen for the first time since 2017. There they were defeated by [[2021–22 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]], bringing their season to a close with a final record of 27–10.

==Previous season==
The [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Musketeers]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 23–13, 8–11 in Big East play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2021–22 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]]. The team received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2021–22 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team|Cleveland State]], [[2021–22 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]], and [[2021–22 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]] to advance to the championship game. There they defeated [[2021–22 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] to win the NIT championship.

Head coach [[Travis Steele]] was fired on March 16, 2022, the day after the first win in the NIT.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-16 |title=Steele out as coach as Xavier plays on in NIT |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33519078/sources-travis-steele-xavier-musketeers-men-basketball-coach |access-date=2022-03-22 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref> Assistant coach [[Jonas Hayes]] was named the interim head coach and coached the team for the four remaining games in the NIT.

On March 19, the school named former Xavier and [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] head coach Sean Miller the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-19 |title=Sean Miller back for second stint as Xavier coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33548495/xavier-expected-hire-sean-miller-coach-return-one-year-away-sport-sources-say |access-date=2022-03-22 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref> Miller previously coached the Musketeers from 2004 to 2009.
